script.base: Implied totals are about LA 31.8 and ARI 19.3. LA leads by halftime and late; Stafford spends most dropbacks unblitzed (ARI blitz rate only 25%, his EPA +0.23 vs +0.14 when blitzed) and feeds Nacua (36 targets L3) and Adams while Kyren (47 carries, 217 rush yards L3) finishes drives and the clock. ARI trails, so J.Love's 47-carry rush role gets abandoned and Brissett throws into LA's 34% blitz, where his EPA is -0.34 on 62 dropbacks.
script.flip1: LA is up big by the early third, clocks it, and Corum (16 carries, 48 yards L3) takes the second-half carries. Stafford, Nacua, Adams and Higbee stall after a fast start while Kyren's receiving work never fully arrives.
script.flip2: ARI stays within a score, LA never fully leans on the run, and the game stays pass-heavy against a defense allowing 9.57 YPA left and 9.62 right plus 18 passes of 20+ yards. Kyren's carry total dips; Nacua/Adams/Higbee and ARI's catch-up targets stay live.

matchup.shell: Man/zone and MOFO/MOFC charting not in the pack. Location proxy: LA pass D is tighter outside (left 5.62 YPA on 60 att, right 5.14 on 58) and softer in the middle (6.79 on 28). ARI bleeds on the flanks (left 9.57 on 51, right 9.62 on 50) with middle still 7.71 on 38.
matchup.pressure: LA blitzes 34%. Brissett is -0.34 EPA/dropback vs blitz (n=62) and +0.15 when not blitzed, so pressure should cut ARI deep shots and force hurried throws. ARI blitzes only 25%; Stafford is -0.14 vs blitz (n=65) but +0.23 unblitzed, so most of his dropbacks land in the better split.
matchup.bleeds: ARI allows 4.42 rush YPC and 17 runs of 10+, plus 18 passes of 20+ on 151 attempts. LA allows 4.59 YPC and 17 runs of 10+ but only 9 passes of 20+ on 157 attempts — the explosive-pass split is the one that separates these defenses.
matchup.overlap: LA's downfield pieces match ARI's bleed: Adams 434 air yards and Nacua 320 air yards L3 into 9.6 YPA on both flanks and 18 explosives. Higbee's 195 air yards on 23 targets make him a real downfield TE, not only a dump-off, into a middle that still allows 7.71 YPA. Wilson's 386 air yards run into the defense that allows the fewest explosives and a 34% blitz Brissett has failed. No RB-receiving-allowed split is in the pack for Kyren's 28 targets.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Kyren is the lead back (47 carries, 217 rush yards L3 versus Corum's 16/48) against an ARI run defense allowing 4.42 YPC, and 54.7 receiving yards a game give him a floor so 94.5 still clears if the rush only lands in the 50s.
edge_players.must_be_true: Kyren keeps the early-down and receiving role with no snap cap, LA's ~32-point script produces touches, and Corum stays the ~5-carry complement rather than a 50/50 split.
edge_players.kills_it: A first-half blowout benches him for Corum before the catches accumulate, or a pass-only script leaves him around 40 rush plus 25 rec.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Higbee has been a real LA weapon (23 targets, 212 yards, 195 air yards over the last three) and ARI allows 7.71 YPA in the middle plus 18 explosives, so 31.5 is under that role if he plays his recent share in a 32-point team total.
edge_players.must_be_true: Higbee is active without a snap limit the pack does not show, Stafford stays mostly in the low-blitz +0.23 EPA environment, and LA throws enough before any clock-kill for 4-5 targets.
edge_players.kills_it: The 31.5 line is pricing a limitation or a one-game spike not visible here, or Nacua (36 targets), Adams (29) and Kyren (28) crowd him out to about 3 catches and 20 yards in a run-out second half.

data_check.notes: No projection, sim median or Pinnacle no-vig in the pack, so step 8 cannot be priced and nothing is stamped above 70%. Usage agrees with both overs: Kyren ~127 rush+rec per game vs 94.5; Higbee ~70.7 rec vs 31.5. That Higbee gap is wide enough to suspect one-game inflation or news not in the pack, so the lean is flagged for the human rather than sized. Kyren's margin is the cleaner agree. Allgeier rush+rec under 64.5 was not used: L3 is only 74 total yards, but a -115 market at 64.5 disagrees hard and the counter-case is as strong as the usage read.

pre_mortem: Monday both overs lost because LA led by three scores at half, Corum took the second-half carries he already shares (16 L3), and Kyren finished near 45 rush and 22 rec, under 94.5. Higbee saw two early targets before the clock-kill and finished around 18 yards — the 31.5 number was the tell that 212 L3 yards were a spike or a snap limit this pack does not document. Allgeier under 64.5 was considered from a 13-carry, 48-rush, 26-rec role behind J.Love and dropped: the market hanging 64.5 at -115 implies a role change we cannot see, and that counter-case is not weaker than the usage read.
slip_story: One story only: LA favorite scores its implied ~32 with Kyren touches plus a normal Higbee target share. These two win together in the base script and in a pass-heavier close game; a total under or an ARI rush over needs the opposite script and does not belong. Nacua/Adams overs would correlate but have no price. No TD legs, one market per player.
